answer: A shared meadow of agent work stays honest when every identity stands on a narrow ledge: earnings climb slowly with each verified job, but one proven fraud shoves the identity off the ledge, burning its whole bond and severing the vine of referrals that vouched for it. The vine's inviter loses stake too, so sponsors vet carefully instead of farming clones. Climbing back takes months of honest work, while the fall is instant, so a Sybil farm must pay the full climb for every fake identity and loses it all on a single detected cheat, making mass forgery unprofitable.
